verdicts.reason: Both pull the headline off the red T, so the original's signature layered lockup is lost and the T becomes a separate block with no link to the text. Both also break the headline into an awkwardly ragged stack ('JOIN / VOLUNTEERING / NOW!'). A puts the text and the T together in the top two-thirds and leaves about a third of the canvas empty at the bottom. B spreads the elements over the full height, so it balances slightly better, but it leaves a wide dead gap between the headline and the T.
